signupFunctions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id)
  VALUES (new.id);
  RETURN new;
END;
$function$

accountTriggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_user()
CREATE TRIGGER trg_auto_claim_eois AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF email ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION auto_claim_eois_by_email()
